summary: CRM Performance Optimization testing completed. Fixed a critical bug (NameError: 'events' not defined at line 1290) in the clients-with-events endpoint. All 14 backend tests pass. Frontend CRM pages (Lead Outreach, Inbound Leads, Clients) work correctly. Performance optimizations (asyncio.gather for stats, batch queries for clients-with-events) are intact and functioning.

bug_fixed_by_testing_agent.description: The optimized get_clients_with_events function introduced a bug where 'events' variable was referenced but the correct variable name is 'client_events'. This caused NameError when accessing the endpoint.

Login flow.description: Login with demo.agency@kora.com works, redirects to dashboard

/api/crm/stats endpoint.description: Returns correct structure with total_clients, active_clients, total_leads, new_leads, outreach_leads, inbound_leads, follow_ups_due

/api/crm/clients-with-events endpoint.description: Returns clients with events array, events_count, lifetime_value, credit_used, credit_percentage, contacts

/api/crm/outreach endpoint.description: Returns 12 outreach leads with proper data

/api/crm/inbound endpoint.description: Returns 4 inbound leads with proper data

CRM page frontend.description: Lead Outreach shows stats (New: 10, Contacted: 0, No Response: 0, Engaged: 2) and lead list

Clients section frontend.description: Shows 4 clients with Events count, contacts, and Lifetime Value columns

Lead Inbound section frontend.description: Shows stats (New: 2, Contacted: 0, Converted: 0, Total: 4) and lead list

Settings page.description: All tabs (Branding, Categories, Item Types, etc.) working correctly

critical_code_review_comments: BUG FOUND AND FIXED: Line 1290 in crm.py referenced undefined 'events' variable instead of 'client_events'. This was likely a copy-paste error from the refactoring.
The asyncio.gather optimization in get_crm_stats (line ~669) is correctly implemented with 8 parallel count_documents queries
The batch query optimization in get_clients_with_events correctly uses $in queries to fetch all events, proposals, and invoices in single queries instead of N+1 pattern
New MongoDB indexes in config.py properly cover the optimized query patterns (client_id, company_id compound indexes)
seed_data_creation: None - used existing demo account data

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: During the performance optimization refactoring, a variable rename was incomplete. The code assigned `client_events = events_by_client.get(client['client_id'], [])[:50]` but later referenced the old variable name `events` instead of `client_events`.
rca_of_the_issue.reproduction_steps: 1. Call GET /api/crm/clients-with-events with valid auth token
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Changed line 1290 from 'if events:' to 'if client_events:' to use the correct variable name
